remarks: Welcome to this exceptional home on a premium cul-de-sac in the gated community of Iron Ridge in Lake Forest. Offered FULLY FURNISHED with professionally designed interiors, this residence is truly move-in ready. The chef's kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring an oversized island, quartz countertops, JennAir appliances, ceiling-high shaker cabinetry, and an extended walk-in pantry. It opens to the family room and dining area in a bright, open layout, where two large sliding glass doors, lead directly to the covered California room, blending indoor and outdoor living.
